The '''Nexus Room''' was a [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] in the southern quadrant of [[Kaas City]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]-era of [[Timeline of galactic history|galactic history]]. The cantina had installed a trio of [[musician droid]]s known as the [[Leisurenauts]] to preform a selection of programmed musical tracks when patrons inputted [[Jukebox tokens|tokens]] into the cantina's [[Jukebox/Legends|jukebox]]. Several millennia after the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] abandoned Dromund Kaas, an archaeological expedition discovered the remnants of the Nexus Room amid the ruins of Kaas City and found the still functioning droid band.<ref name="PartI">{{SW|url=news/slugthrowers-an-overview-of-popular-music-and-musicians-in-a-galaxy-far-far-away-part-1|series=Slugthrowers: An Overview of Popular Music and Musicians in a Galaxy Far, Far Away|text=Part 1|nolive=1}}</ref>
